description: Free and open-source desktop translation tool
notes: Tolk stores its settings and API keys outside the install directory, in %USERPROFILE%\.tolk\config.json, so that data is not managed by Scoop and survives reinstall or uninstall of this manifest.
Tolk's built-in self-updater expects an installer layout, so it may report that this copy must be updated with the official installer from https://tolk.achord.cn. Use 'scoop update tolk' to upgrade.
Screenshot translation uses the Windows built-in OCR engine and requires the matching OCR language pack to be installed in Windows.
